entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: ¶<<Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.>> I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations. {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction} {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

words.text: . {Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction} {to all...: Heb. to generation and generation}

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: ¶And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? [who] among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all [them that are] about him.

words.text: , and to be had in reverence

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: O LORD God of hosts, who [is] a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

words.text: like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm. {Rahab: or, Egypt} {thy...: Heb. the arm of thy strength}

words.text: . {Rahab: or, Egypt} {thy...: Heb. the arm of thy strength}

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: The heavens [are] thine, the earth also [is] thine: [as for] the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

words.text: them. {the fulness...: or, all it containeth}

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, [and] high is thy right hand. {a...: Heb. an arm with might}

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: Justice and judgment [are] the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face. {habitation: or, establishment}

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: ¶Blessed [is] the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For thou [art] the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For the LORD [is] our defence; and the Holy One of Israel [is] our king. {the LORD...: or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel}

words.text: . {the LORD...: or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel}

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: ¶Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon [one that is] mighty; I have exalted [one] chosen out of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: But my faithfulness and my mercy [shall be] with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

words.text: [shall be] with him: and in my name

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: He shall cry unto me, Thou [art] my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: Also I will make him [my] firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: His seed also will I make [to endure] for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments; {break: Heb. profane}

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail. {will...: Heb. I will not make void from him} {to fall: Heb. to lie}

words.text: from him, nor suffer my faithfulness
. {will...: Heb. I will not make void from him} {to fall: Heb. to lie}

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

words.text: the thing that is gone out

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David. {that...: Heb. if I lie}

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and [as] a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: ¶But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

words.text: ; thou hast made all his enemies

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

words.text: , and hast not made him to stand

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground. {glory: Heb. brightness}

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

words.text: my time is: wherefore hast thou made

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man [is he that] liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: Lord, where [are] thy former lovingkindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; [how] I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty people;

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Blessed [be] the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
